userStories.title: Extend the Typed Console Data Boundary
userStories.description: As a console operator, I want typed run-detail and node-message query endpoints, so that the console inspect UI can read raw events, projected node states, and agent transcripts safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/experiments/console/skills/runs.node-messages.test.ts and packages/web/src/experiments/console/skills/workflows.dag-nodes.test.ts asserting client contracts with spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').
Add type aliases WorkflowEvent, WorkflowNodeState, WorkflowNodeMessage, WorkflowNodeMessagesResponse from components['schemas'] to skills/runs.ts.
Expand ConsoleRunDetail interface to include run, events, rawEvents, nodeStates, approval, and usage.
getRun('run/1') requests /api/workflows/runs/run%2F1, returns untouched rawEvents, nodeStates, and approval before presentation adapters run, while preserving existing events, run, and usage.
listNodeMessages('run/1', 'node a') requests /api/workflows/runs/run%2F1/nodes/node%20a/messages and returns text, tool, and status entries without reshaping them.
Non-2xx responses from getRun or listNodeMessages reject through requestJson instead of returning an empty fallback.
Add collision-safe keys K.nodeMessages and K.workflowDagNodes with individually encoded segments to store/keys.ts.

Export DagNode from skills/workflows.ts and implement getWorkflowDagNodes(workflowName, cwd) requesting /api/workflows?cwd=... and returning raw workflow definition nodes unchanged; missing workflow rejects with Workflow not found: <workflowName>.

userStories.title: Establish Approval and Inspect-Status Policy
userStories.description: As a console operator, I want typed approval-context parsing and an awaiting-to-running inspect status policy, so that gate decisions are parsed safely and human interaction controls are not shown prematurely.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/experiments/console/components/inspect/read-approval-context.test.ts and inspect-status.test.ts covering accepted/rejected shapes and status mapping.

Implement read-approval-context.ts with ApprovalContext interface and readApprovalContext(value: unknown): ApprovalContext | null requiring string nodeId and message, accepting only approval, plannotator_gate, child_workflow, interactive_loop, and writeback types.
Implement getPlannotatorReviewUrl({ status, approval }) accepting review links only when run status is paused and URL uses http: or https:.

Implement inspect-status.ts exporting InspectStatus ('pending' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'skipped'), inspectStatus(value: string), inspectStatusLabel(value: string), and isInspectRunLive(status: string).
inspectStatus and inspectStatusLabel map 'awaiting' to 'running'; pending, running, completed, failed, and skipped pass through; other strings map to pending.
isInspectRunLive returns true only for 'running' and 'paused' status.
bun test src/experiments/console/components/inspect/read-approval-context.test.ts src/experiments/console/components/inspect/inspect-status.test.ts passes from packages/web.

userStories.title: Build the Unmerged Log Projection
userStories.description: As a console operator, I want unmerged log rows and synthetic fallback states, so that ordinary node runs, loop iterations, and route decisions display distinctly in chronological order without duplicating usage ledger data.
acceptanceCriteria: Create build-log-rows.test.ts, synthesize-log-node-states.test.ts, and build-console-log-entries.test.ts covering ordinary, loop-iteration, route-decision, fallback states, and usage placement.
Implement build-log-rows.ts with LogRow and LogRowSelection ('node' | 'loop_iteration' | 'route_iteration') sorting by source event-array order, then projected-state index.

Group loop rows by positive safe-integer data.iteration and route rows by positive safe-integer data.execution_seq; suppress the ordinary row for loop or route-loop nodes when specific iteration/route rows exist.

Implement synthesize-log-node-states.ts where existing projected states always win and synthetic states are added only for missing node ids from loop-iteration metadata or selectable declared pause (approval, plannotator_gate, child_workflow; excluding interactive_loop and writeback).
Implement build-console-log-entries.ts with ConsoleLogEntry interface deriving startedAt, durationMs, costUsd, numTurns, stopReason, skipReason, skipExpr, and showNodeUsage.
Set showNodeUsage to true only on the final chronological row for a given nodeId so cumulative ledger data appears once.
Use runStartedAt as the final timestamp fallback for every row.

userStories.title: Resolve Room Types, Data, and Selection
userStories.description: As a console operator, I want type-aware room resolution, deterministic per-room data selectors, message slicing, and URL/live selection precedence, so that every selected node displays the correct room content.
acceptanceCriteria: Create resolve-room-kind.test.ts, select-room-data.test.ts, select-node-room-messages.test.ts, and console-inspect-selection.test.ts covering all node body types and selection precedence.

Implement resolve-room-kind.ts with RoomKind ('agent' | 'stdout' | 'gate' | 'workflow' | 'route_loop' | 'loop_group') and NodeBodyKind identifying bodies by schema keys, qualifying loop-group children with dot-separated ids, and returning agent room with nodeType 'unknown' only after approval and event fallbacks fail.
Implement select-room-data.ts with selectNodeStdout, selectGateChrome, selectChildRun, selectRouteDecision, and selectLoopGroupChrome returning typed data without throwing on malformed payloads.

Implement select-node-room-messages.ts sorting messages by seq, preserving full transcript for non-loop selections, slicing loop rows from matching iteration_started to terminal/next-start, and returning full transcript if iteration markers are missing.

Implement console-inspect-selection.ts with readNodeSearchParam, resolveInitialInspectSelection, and selectInspectNode where valid ?node= wins, falling back to first inspect-running node, then declared approval, then first log row.

userStories.title: Render the Console-Owned Node Room
userStories.description: As a console operator, I want a single console-owned node room component that renders agent, stdout, gate, child run, route, and loop-group rooms with 1s live agent polling, so that node details are viewable without premature HITL controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/experiments/console/test/install-happy-dom.ts installing and restoring global DOM environment for React 19 tests.

Create ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx testing agent transcript, tool entries, live polling (1s setInterval), stdout pre, gate decision controls, child run link, route decision, loop-group view, and absence of Epic 6 UI.
Implement ConsoleNodeRoom.tsx adhering to ConsoleNodeRoomProps interface with onClose, loadMessages, and stable room header.
Poll node messages via refetch() every 1,000 ms only when isLive is true and room kind is 'agent'; clear interval on dependency change and unmount.
Render agent messages (text, tool, status) in server sequence order; render tool inputs/outputs as formatted JSON; format markdown text; map status 'awaiting' to 'running'.

Render bash/script stdout in pre with exit code and truncation metadata; render gate message with ApprovalPanel when canDecide is true; render child workflow run deep-link /console/p/:projectId/r/:childRunId.
Do not read, render, or import pending_interactions, AskCard, or ChatComposer; do not display 'Waiting on you' or 'awaiting' labels.
